svg.title: Logeman Lab
svg.desc: Logeman Lab identity, version 4. Top band: three enhancers on a DNA strand, dotted contacts converging on a transcription start site. Lower left: alpha-helix, beta-sheet and connecting loop. Lower right: a five-cell microcircuit with excitatory (arrowhead) and inhibitory (bar) terminals, wired so each cell sends a single output type. Four colours. No transforms: every path is in final user-space coordinates.
